snippet.title: Vampire Crawlers coming day one with Xbox Game Pass in 2026 | Xbox Partner Preview 2025
snippet.description:
Deal world-ending combos and blitz through infested dungeons! Vampire Crawlers: The Turbo Wildcard from Vampire Survivors is a casual, turn‑based deckbuilder with roguelite elements. Coming to Xbox Series X|S and Xbox on PC in 2026, day one with Xbox Game Pass and Xbox Play Anywhere.
